definition: An element of the finite support set of a normal witness.
mathematical_role: Domain element for support measure and witness fields.
relation_to_current_operation: Contraction chooses at least two coordinates.
caveat: Only inside normal support witness contract.

definition: The tuple of syntactic positions in payload, certificate, frontier, shell, tail, motif, and family-chain fields where a coordinate appears.
relation_to_canonicalization: Canonical roles must be compatible after renaming.
relation_to_payload_refinement: Role equality is a payload-refinement precondition.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status role equality is required for status transfer.
caveat: Role extraction for arbitrary witnesses is still a contract.

definition: Two coordinates are equivalent when their selected syntactic role, payload role, canonical motif role, and status role are pairwise congruent under the current witness contract.
relation_to_current_operation: Core equivalence relation for this operation.
relation_to_canonicalization: Must be stable under canonical renaming.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Requires counterexample-status congruence; this remains open.
caveat: Not every apparent symmetry is accepted.

definition: Coordinates have identical occurrence patterns in the presented normal-form fields after allowed renaming.
relation_to_current_operation: Provides a concrete contract for quotient input.
relation_to_payload_refinement: May imply payload equivalence only with payload congruence.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Does not by itself prove status preservation.

definition: Replacing either coordinate by the other preserves all witness predicates relevant to the current obstruction.
mathematical_role: Strong relation needed for full correctness.
caveat: Not fully proved for arbitrary support-growth witnesses.

definition: Coordinates are indistinguishable by canonical motif rank and row equality data.
mathematical_role: Prevents quotient from changing motif class.
relation_to_current_operation: Contraction requires it when motif fields are active.
relation_to_canonicalization: Adjacent to canonical motif compression but not identical.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Does not prove counterexample status alone.
caveat: Do not confuse with canonical motif compression.

definition: All payload components indexed by the coordinates are equal or refine to a single quotient component.
relation_to_canonicalization: Canonicalized payload must agree after quotient.
caveat: Payload equality and refinement remain distinct.

definition: Counterexample certificate/status predicates are invariant when equivalent coordinates are identified.
relation_to_canonicalization: Canonical status fields must commute with quotient.

definition: Equivalent coordinates occupy interchangeable family-chain layer roles after quotienting.
mathematical_role: Keeps recognized source form after contraction.
relation_to_current_operation: Needed when contraction is used in family-chain branch.
relation_to_canonicalization: Depends on layer projection/canonical proof-ready skeleton.
caveat: Recognized-source only, not arbitrary witness completeness.

definition: Within accepted equivalence classes, reflexive, symmetric, and transitive closure is used to form quotient classes.
relation_to_current_operation: Used to define quotient coordinate set.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status congruence under closure remains open.
caveat: Only for accepted relation, not all semantic equivalences.

definition: A nonempty block of support coordinates under the accepted equivalence relation.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status components merge only under status congruence.

definition: The representative coordinate replacing one equivalence class in the quotient support set.
relation_to_canonicalization: May be chosen then normalized canonically.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Carries merged status only if congruent.
caveat: Representative choice must not be read as canonical proof.

definition: Failure to prove equivalence or congruence routes to a named blocker, later operation, or higher-support escape after operations are exhausted.
relation_to_canonicalization: May route to canonical motif compression.
relation_to_payload_refinement: Payload failure routes to payload blocker.
relation_to_counterexample_status: Status failure routes to status blocker.

definition: Equivalent coordinate notation is contract-ready with syntactic/class/quotient notions first-class and status congruence open.
